description.text: Main Courses: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Public Finance, International Economics, Monetary and Banking, International Finance, Securities Analysis and Investment, Insurance, Commercial Bank Mangement, Central Banking, Theory and Practice of Investing Bank

duration.text: The Finance at Soochow University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK HSK level 3-6 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required
